quizName:
Hardest Questions in South carolina
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: Drowsiness affects driving the same way alcohol and drugs do. What can it do?
questions.explanation: Lack of sleep causes poor driving. Like drugs and alcohol, drowsiness slows your reaction time, reduces awareness, and harms your judgment.

questions.question: You see lowered gates and flashing lights at a railroad crossing. What should you do?

options.text: Drive around the gates if you don't see a train.
Stop completely behind the gates. Wait until the tracks are clear and the gates lift before driving on.
Slow down and drive around the gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely behind the gates. Wait until the tracks are clear and the gates lift before driving on.
questions.explanation: You must stop at railroad crossings with warning signs, signals, or flaggers. It is illegal to drive around lowered gates.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street in the wrong direction.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic on a green light must let oncoming traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic on a green light must let oncoming traffic go first.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal. It tells drivers that left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way and must wait for oncoming traffic to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. If you see this sign, turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What could cause you to crash?

options.text: Taking your eyes off the road.
Taking your hands off the wheel.
Taking your attention away from driving.

questions.explanation: Anything that takes your attention from driving, your eyes from the road, or your hands from the wheel is a distraction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn is allowed here.
You can turn left only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn is allowed here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: When stopped by police for a violation or equipment check, you must show:
questions.explanation: You must provide your driver's license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance. All drivers must have these three documents when driving.

questions.question: When should you slow down while driving?

options.text: When roads are wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow or winding roads, near intersections, near railroad crossings, on hills, in sharp curves, around pedestrians, and on wet or slippery roads.

questions.question: What can harm a person's driving ability?
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires being in good physical condition. Alcohol, legal and illegal drugs, and drowsiness can all impair driving.

questions.question: You missed your exit on a freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Turn quickly from your current lane.
Keep driving until the next exit or safe place to turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep driving until the next exit or safe place to turn around.
questions.explanation: If you miss your exit, continue to the next turn or exit where you can safely turn around. It is illegal to back up on a freeway shoulder.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left at a green light to yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: You are driving on a two-lane highway and see a stopped school bus with red flashing lights. You:

options.text: May pass if the way is clear.
May pass if a pedestrian indicates that the way is clear.
May not pass until the school bus driver turns off the flashing lights and continues driving.
Must turn on your emergency flashers.

questions.correctAnswerText: May not pass until the school bus driver turns off the flashing lights and continues driving.
questions.explanation: You must stop for a school bus with flashing red lights on a two-lane road, no matter which direction you are traveling.

questions.question: Drivers should keep a safe distance from cyclists.
questions.explanation: You must be careful around cyclists and keep a safe distance between your vehicle and them.

questions.question: Before turning, you should:
questions.explanation: Turn on your turn signal three to four seconds before you turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around and go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: When approaching railroad tracks, you should:

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be prepared to stop.
Speed up to cross the tracks before the gate is lowered.
Try to drive around a lowered gate.
Not pay attention to how many tracks there are to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be prepared to stop.
questions.explanation: Look both ways, listen for trains, slow down, and be ready to stop for trains or other vehicles on the tracks.

questions.question: Distracted driving can be caused by:

options.text: Talking or texting on a cellular phone.
Changing a radio station or CD.

questions.explanation: Drivers make about 200 decisions for every mile driven. Any activity that takes your attention away from driving is dangerous.

questions.question: Before starting a parked vehicle, you should:

options.text: Check the fuel gauge, adjust the volume on the radio, and shift gears.
Adjust the side mirror and make sure your heater works.
Adjust the seat, adjust the mirrors, and fasten your safety belt.

questions.correctAnswerText: Adjust the seat, adjust the mirrors, and fasten your safety belt.
questions.explanation: Walk around your vehicle to check for obstacles. Before starting the engine, fasten your safety belt and adjust your seat and mirrors to safe positions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means an action is not allowed. Right turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign tells you that a railroad crossing is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces for people with disability license plates, disabled veteran plates, or disability placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. You cannot make a right turn at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign warns of one type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to what is coming up. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that roadwork is coming. In a work zone, watch for temporary traffic control signs and equipment.

questions.question: You should never park where:

options.text: Within 50 feet of a railroad crossing.
Within 30 feet of any flashing signal on the side of a roadway.

questions.explanation: Do not park within 50 feet of a railroad crossing, within 20 feet of a crosswalk, or within 30 feet of a traffic signal, stop sign, or flashing beacon on the side of the road.

questions.question: When double solid yellow lines mark the center of the road, passing is:
questions.explanation: Double yellow lines mean that drivers in both directions cannot cross the center line to pass.
